project: PM2.5 Hyperlocal Mapping (Delhi Prototype, Milestones 1-14 locked)
purpose: Phase 1 audit: enumerate every geographic/location-specific dependency prior to a backward-compatible globalization refactor.
method: Source-wide search of config.yaml, run.py, src/**/*.py, api/**/*.py, dashboard/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}, tests/*.py, README.md, docs/architecture.md. Generated artifacts (data/processed, data/outputs, models) referenced only as corroboration.

delhi_aoi_coordinates.summary: Delhi bbox (77.0-77.4 lon / 28.4-28.8 lat) and Delhi feature coordinates embedded in config, sample-data generators, and dashboard map center.
findings: src/data_pipeline.py:797-801 5 Delhi station rows (Punjabi Bagh/India Gate/Dwarka/UoD/Rohini coords)
src/data_pipeline.py:2766,2781 DEM bounds + Yamuna river at lon 77.2

crs_hardcoding.summary: EPSG:32643 (UTM zone 43N, central meridian 75E) assumed everywhere; EPSG:4326 used as project CRS. Not globally valid.

grid_dimension_assumptions.summary: Grids are mostly built dynamically from AOI bounds, but one hard-coded cell count exists.
findings: src/data_pipeline.py:5908 parent_1km_valid_coverage denominator hard-coded to 1804 cells
src/data_pipeline.py:2959 OSM analysis grid ID f"{c:03d}_{r:03d}"

date_hardcoding.summary: Dates centralized in config but embedded in sample data, tests, and checklist.

cpcb_only_assumptions.summary: CPCB treated as the only ground-truth source; India-only validation window (lat 5-40 / lon 65-100).

output_filename_patterns.summary: Output filename patterns encode scope/date but no region namespace; not overwrite-safe for global outputs.
findings: api/main.py:53-63 pm25_500m_{date}.tif, pm25_1km_{date}.tif, aqi_500m_{date}.tif, hotspots_500m.geojson, hotspot_statistics.json, final_metadata.json, uncertainty_status.json, cpcb_station_summary.parquet, cpcb_pm25_daily.parquet, model_feature_importance.csv, model_metadata.json

dashboard_map_center.summary: Map initialized at Delhi center/zoom; tests embed Delhi coordinates.

aoi_geometry_ingestion.summary: AOI read from a single fixed boundary file.

osm_assumptions.summary: OSM is already AOI-driven (graph_from_polygon) but metric CRS and grid resolution are Delhi-hardened.

aqi_cpcb_tables.summary: CPCB AQI breakpoints/categories duplicated in config, data_pipeline, and dashboard colormaps.

path_assumptions.summary: Some paths hard-coded in data_pipeline instead of config.

sample_data_bounds.summary: Synthetic/sample raster generators embed Delhi bounds, resolutions, and lat-scale.

resolution_wiring.summary: 1000m/500m resolutions are configurable and wired through config; resolution constants fine for global reuse.

architecture_observations: Pipeline is mostly AOI-driven: grids built from aoi.total_bounds; raster dims from frame bounds. Dominant hard-coded geography is in sample-data generators and one 1804-cell constant.
EPSG:32643 is baked in at all layers including a dashboard string-match and API warping; must be replaced by a centralized CRS utility.
API is deliberately data-driven (reads existing files only) - geographic coupling limited to filename patterns and fixed map center.
Only date 2025-01-01 has generated output; no other dates are available.
globalization_scope: centralized CRS utility (EPSG:4326 geographic + per-AOI projected + geodesic area/length)
tile-based global processing (configurable tile size, merge, caching)
AOI-aware dataset ingestion interfaces + dataset registry + data availability
generalized ground-truth schema (station_id/source/country/lat/lon/timestamp/PM2.5/units/quality_flag) with CPCB preserved as India source
generalized inference (date/AOI/resolution/model_scope), AQI schemes (india_cpcb/us_epa/none), AOI-relative hotspot detection
dashboard Global/India/Delhi/Custom AOI modes with honest status
safety_constraints: Preserve Delhi prototype unchanged (run.py, uvicorn api.main:app, npm run dev, existing tests).
No fabricated global PM2.5, accuracy, confidence, or uncertainty.
No use of the Delhi-trained model as a global model; global model scope stays unavailable until trained+validated on global observations.
No silent AQI-standard mixing; AQI standard always labeled.
